title: steps/memoryContextRetrieval payload (ACS-Provenance profile)
description: Strict variant of memory-context-retrieval.json for deployments running provenance_producer: deterministic / claiming ACS-Provenance. Every result MUST carry provenance (origin: retrieved, derived_from non-empty) and lineage with the stored provenance and summary, so stored untrusted content cannot be read back as fresh or trusted. ACS-Core deployments validate against the base schema instead.
